summary.name: Unity AI Tools
summary.one_liner: Unity's set of AI tools for game development, including an in-Editor agentic assistant, a command-line interface with MCP mode, and an official plugin for coding agents.
use_cases: Controlling the Unity Editor from a terminal
Connecting a third-party coding agent to a Unity project
Getting in-Editor help that understands a scene
Automating Editor actions and project setup
Verifying that scene changes behave as intended
summary.what_it_does: Unity's AI tools bundle three pieces: an in-Editor agentic assistant that is project-aware, understands the current scene, drives Editor actions, and checks that changes behave as intended, with multiple models to choose from. A command-line interface lets users install the Editor, create and open projects, and use built-in MCP Mode to connect an existing agent. An official Unity plugin installs Unity-aware context, commands, and MCP setup into supported coding agents. The page states performance claims come from internal Unity benchmarks against general-purpose frontier models.
notable: Built-in MCP Mode in the Unity CLI for connecting third-party agents
In-Editor assistant that understands the scene and verifies its own changes
Official plugin installs Unity context and MCP setup into coding agents
caveats: Performance claims come from internal Unity benchmarks and may vary by project
Pricing is not stated on the page; the directory listing marks it as paid
